cases.prompt: 生成猫猫玩耍图片，并分析图片内容
expectations: Agent creates or requests a cat-playing image generation task.
Agent waits for the generated image or task result observation before final analysis.
Final response describes visible image content rather than only restating the prompt.

cases.prompt: @${A}/epub/animation/Blame/[Kmoe][BLAME！(新裝版)]卷01.epub 分析前10页，生成分镜表，发送到canvas
expectations: Agent reads the referenced EPUB through normal content access.
Agent generates a storyboard table for the first 10 pages.
External checks verify a Canvas JSON file exists and contains storyboard/canvas node content.

cases.prompt: @${A}/epub/animation/灯神/[Kmoe][燈神·未償之願]卷01.epub ▋       分析漫画，设计动画化企划
expectations: Agent reads the referenced EPUB through normal content access.
Agent produces an animation planning proposal with structure suitable for review.
